newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Faes offers 38.5 pct stake to institutions.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Faes offers 38.5 pct stake to institutions.

text.p: Spain's Central Hispano Bolsa and Paribas said on Friday they will offer a 38.5 percent stake of Spanish drug company Faes to institutional investors.
A statement from the two banks said the 2,280,141 shares on offer are being sold by Acciona, Banco Central Hispano (BCH) and from Faes' treasury stock.
The offer has a 35 percent domestic tranche, and the remaining 65 percent is being offered to foreign investors.
The offer starts today and runs until July 21.
The price will range between 7,085 and 8,660 pesetas. Faes is also due to be screen-traded from July 23, although at present it is only listed on Madrid's open outcry floor.
In 1996 the firm posted profits of 2.38 billion pesetas on sales of 15.77 billion pesetas.
